# CANDIDATE: EXTEND_WEEKLY_DTE_TO_3DTE_4DTE

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Extending the DTE limit from 2DTE to 3DTE/4DTE for the vwap_continuation signal (ITM-2 puts, -8%/+30%) will continue the monotonic OOS exp/tr increase observed from 0DTE→1DTE→2DTE, capturing additional edge through reduced intraday theta decay while maintaining identical directional accuracy. The edge exists because longer-dated options lose less premium to time decay during the holding period, improving expectancy without altering win rate.

## Mechanism

Identical to WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE: enter on the first qualifying morning bar (≤10:30 ET) that continues in-trend (breakout/pullback vs session VWAP) using the vwap_continuation signal. Buy ITM-2 SPY puts with DTE options (now allowing 0DTE, 1DTE, 2DTE, 3DTE, or 4DTE) at next bar open. Exit at -8% premium stop (chart-stop primary) or +30% profit target, intraday only (no overnight holds). Position sizing and risk rules unchanged. Uses same OPRA backfill infrastructure extended to options_3dte/4dte.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account realizes ~14% of headline P&L due to 50% risk cap and min 3-contract floor.
2. **Sample bias:** Using same vwap_continuation signal as WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE (n≈1,200 trades over 2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18). Extending DTE buckets adds 3DTE/4DTE samples (~240 trades each estimated). Overfit risk: monotonic DTE trend may reverse beyond 2DTE; requires OOS walk-forward to confirm robustness.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window 2025Q3-2026Q2 not yet computed for 3DTE/4DTE)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J days not yet simulated with 3DTE/4DTE OPRA fills)
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: 3DTE/4DTE could underperform 2DTE if theta decay accelerates nonlinearly with DTE (unlikely but possible with term structure shifts).
   - Max drawdown: series of -8% stops could accumulate more over higher DTE due to wider strikes (same ITM-2 but higher premium) increasing dollar risk per trade.
   - Blow-up scenario: volatility expansion causing option premium to gap against intraday stop (e.g., IV crush on entry day triggering stop despite favorable SPY move).
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (if top 5 days exceed 60% of P&L, concentration disclosure needed per OP-20).
